Daily Devotional

December 12

6 Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near: (Isaiah 55:6 KJV)

You need to seek the Lord while He is available, as He will not always be found as shown in Genesis (Genesis 6:3). Also you must be drawn by the Holy Spirit in order to be saved (John 6:44). When the Spirit leads you to be saved, and you feel the tug of God, don’t delay but come to repentance and salvation right then while it is being offered, as that is when He is near. So many people feel the drawing of the Holy Spirit, but think that they will just wait, or that they are not worthy, at that time. None of us were worthy of being saved (Romans 3:23), but God offers it to us while we are yet sinners so don’t delay in your accepting His offer. Also, by continually living in sin, you will harden your heart toward God, and if you wait, you might find that you no longer would respond to the call of God. Your eternal future is too important to put off, and possibly miss altogether, so respond to God’s call when you feel it. Hell will be full of people who heard the Gospel of Jesus, and felt the call, but decided to wait until later to respond. Don’t be one of those, as when this life is over, it will be too late to be saved.

Many people will miss the call to salvation, because they think they will just wait for a better time, and are under the impression that they will not be able to have any fun if they become Christians. The joy and absolute peace that knowing God causes you to have, is worth more than all the sin in the world, and can not be found in any other way, than to come to God and let Him pour His love out on you. If you fully understand that God is love (1 John 4:8), then when you experience it for yourself, you will be amazed at the peace and joy that will consume you. No longer will the fear of death bother you (1 Corinthians 15:55), as it is only a ticket to heaven. We all have an empty space inside of us that only can be filled with the love of God so don’t delay, but find out what love and fulfillment is all about. Being a Christian is more fun and fulfilling than anyone can imagine. Try it, you will like it. Thank you Jesus for your Grace and Love.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
